label: RECORDED LIVE READ-ONLY EVIDENCE, 2026-11-09 (UTC). Robinhood mainnet 4663. The agent audit code path (fetchGoPlusTokenSecurity, createLpFetcher, evaluateCommunity with audit-policy-v1, TTL 600 s) was run from the compiled agent/ sources. No credential, no on-chain write, no funds moved.

inputs.poolKindDecision: v2/v3 decided by on-chain probe (token0/token1 plus getReserves or slot0), not by DexScreener labels; Uniswap v4 pool ids (32-byte) and native-ETH quotes are unsupported by the fetcher (D32)

endpoints.rpc: https://rpc.mainnet.chain.robinhood.com (User-Agent valtrum-hackathon-readonly/1.0; reads at the latest block number; not archive)
endpoints.dexscreener: https://api.dexscreener.com latest/dex/search?q=, token-pairs/v1/robinhood/<token>, token-profiles/latest/v1, token-boosts (chain id: robinhood)
endpoints.explorer: explorer.chain.robinhood.com and explorer.mainnet.chain.robinhood.com: TLS handshake failure from curl; not retried, not bypassed

coverage.notQueriedNote: GoPlus rate-limited the client (code 4029) after about 100 requests; queries were paced and the remaining low-priority tokens (lowest DexScreener liquidity first) were not queried. Tokens with search liquidity below USD 5,000 cannot reach the USD 10,000 gate and were skipped.

notAuditedTokenizedStocksOrBelowGate.note: GoPlus data present, but a tokenized stock (name contains Robinhood Token or a bullet) or not a memecoin, or DexScreener liquidity below USD 10,000; not run through evaluateCommunity
